operation: Explicitly materialize existing internal image splits; not a new random partition
historical_split_note: Byte hash of the split file used by the completed HoVer-Net runs. It is cited by baselines/hovernet/run_records and by source_original_split_manifest_sha256 in Result/segmentation_checkpoint_identities.csv. It is not the hash of either published CSV.

training_split_manifest.role: Train/validation/test roles used by CellNura training. CoNSeP has 5 validation images and CRCHisto has 12; those images are train in the baseline split manifest.

baseline_split_manifest.role: Hash registered in baselines/catalog.json. Official train/test roles only; the 17 internal validation images stay labeled train and are defined in external_validation_splits.json.
